clauses.title: PRINCIPAL LOAN COMMITMENT
clauses.verbatim_text: Lender agrees to disburse to Borrower a single-draw commercial term loan in the aggregate principal amount of three million five hundred thousand dollars ($3,500,000) for hotel facility expansion.
obligations: Lender must disburse single-draw loan of $3,500,000 to Borrower for hotel facility expansion
rights: Borrower has right to receive $3,500,000 term loan disbursement
conditions: Single-draw disbursement specifically designated for hotel facility expansion
material_claims: Disbursement purpose is hotel facility expansion

clauses.title: INTEREST RATE AND REPAYMENT SCHEDULE
clauses.verbatim_text: Borrower shall pay interest on unpaid principal at a fixed rate of seven point two five percent (7.25%) per annum, payable in monthly installments over a maturity period of sixty (60) months. Uncured default accrues penalty interest at twelve point zero percent (12.0%) per annum.
obligations: Borrower must pay fixed 7.25% per annum interest in monthly installments over 60 months maturity
Borrower must pay penalty interest of 12.0% per annum on uncured default
rights: Lender receives 7.25% monthly interest and 12.0% default penalty interest
conditions: 12.0% default rate triggered only upon uncured default
material_claims: Fixed interest rate of 7.25% per annum payable in monthly installments
Penalty interest rate is 12.0% per annum upon uncured default

clauses.title: FINANCIAL COVENANTS AND DEBT SERVICE
clauses.verbatim_text: Borrower covenants to maintain a minimum Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) of not less than 1.25x tested at the end of each fiscal quarter. Failure to maintain DSCR constitutes an immediate Event of Default.
obligations: Borrower must maintain minimum Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) of >= 1.25x tested quarterly
rights: Lender can declare immediate Event of Default if DSCR falls below 1.25x
conditions: Tested quarterly at the end of each fiscal quarter
material_claims: Minimum Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) of 1.25x
DSCR tested at the end of each fiscal quarter
Failure to maintain DSCR is an immediate Event of Default

clauses.title: PREPAYMENT PREMIUMS
clauses.verbatim_text: Borrower may prepay the outstanding principal subject to a prepayment fee of three percent (3.0%) in Year 1, two percent (2.0%) in Year 2, one percent (1.0%) in Year 3, and zero percent thereafter.
obligations: Borrower must pay sliding prepayment fee if electing to prepay principal
rights: Borrower has right to prepay outstanding principal balance
Lender receives prepayment fee: 3.0% in Year 1, 2.0% in Year 2, 1.0% in Year 3, 0% thereafter
conditions: Prepayment fees: 3.0% in Year 1, 2.0% in Year 2, 1.0% in Year 3, 0% in Year 4+
exceptions: No prepayment fee after Year 3 (zero percent thereafter)
material_claims: Prepayment permitted subject to fee schedule
3.0% fee in Year 1, 2.0% in Year 2, 1.0% in Year 3

clauses.title: ACCELERATION AND REMEDIES ON DEFAULT
clauses.verbatim_text: Upon the occurrence of any Event of Default, Lender may declare the entire outstanding principal balance, accrued unpaid interest, and all related fees immediately due and payable without presentment or demand.
obligations: Borrower must immediately pay entire principal balance, accrued interest, and fees upon default acceleration
rights: Lender has right to accelerate entire outstanding debt without presentment or demand upon Event of Default
conditions: Triggered upon the occurrence of any Event of Default
material_claims: Lender can declare entire principal, accrued interest, and fees immediately due upon Event of Default
No presentment or demand required for acceleration

clauses.title: GOVERNING FORUM AND VENUE
clauses.verbatim_text: This Agreement and all promissory obligations shall be governed by the laws of the State of New York, and Borrower consents to personal jurisdiction in the courts of New York County, New York.
obligations: Borrower submits to personal jurisdiction in New York County, New York courts
material_claims: Governed by the laws of the State of New York
Personal jurisdiction in courts of New York County, New York
